senses.gloss: (denom. of תֶּבֶל) to mix; to spice, season.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 23b:20">Men. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>תִּיבְּלָהּ בקצח וכ׳</he> if he seasoned it (the unleavened bread) with cumin &c.

Ib. 21ᵃ יכול יְתַבְּלֶנּוּ כתבן בטיט Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. יתבוננו) you may think (that t’bon’nennu means,) that he must mix it with salt as straw is mixed with clay; Yalk. Lev. 454 (not בתבן וטיט); v. בִּין.
<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 2:4">Orl. II, 4</cite> <he>כל המחמץ והמְתַבֵּל וכ׳</he> whosoever leavens, or seasons, or mixes with T’rumah &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 2:15">Ib. 15</cite> <he>תבלין … לא באלו כדי לתַבֵּל … ונצטרפו ותִבְּלוּ</he> if spices of T’rumah and of mixed seeds get into a pot, neither being sufficient to season the dish, but seasoning it in combination.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 2:1:16">Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᶜ</cite> top a dish of second tithes <he>שתִּיבְּלוֹ וכ׳</he> which one seasoned with spices of a profane character; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְתוּבָּל</he>; f. <he>מְתוּבֶּלֶת</he> &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:1:11">Y. Pes. X, 37ᶜ</cite> <he>מבושל כמ׳</he> (ed. <he>כדי תבל</he>, <he>כתיתבל</he>, corr. acc.) boiled wine is in ritual law like spiced wine.
Tosef. Pes. I (II), 33 מצה המת׳ וכ׳ spiced Matsah; a. e.—Trnsf. to improve, refine.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:3">Gen. R. s. 23</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 38:6">Yalk. ib. 38</cite> (play on <he>תובל קין</he>) <he>ת׳ עבודתו של קין וכ׳</he> (Gen. R. <he>עבירתו</he>) he refined Cain’s work (sin); Cain killed without any tool &c.

senses.gloss: (v. תֵּבֵל) to make rich of growth.—Part. pass. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 37:7">Sifré Deut. 37</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 943:1">Yalk. Prov. 943</cite>, v. <cite ref="V00052"><he>תֵּבֵל</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be mixed, seasoned. Tosef. Pes. l. c. בין שנִתַּבְּלָה וכ׳ (ed. Zuck. שתִּיבְּלָהּ) whether it was seasoned in a stew-dish or in a pot.

units: Yalk. Gen. 47 (ref. to הוחל, Gen. IV, 26, and play on תובל) חזרו מִתַּבְּלִין בכל כעס וכ׳ they turned and denied themselves with all kind of provocation (sins), as we read, Tubal Cain &c.; שחזרו להִתַּבֵּל בזנות וכ׳ they turned to defile themselves with voluptuousness, as we read (Lev. XX, 12) tebel ʿasu
